content:
Elena (CEO): Short weekly exec note — three priorities: 1) ensure private beta is stable & predictable, 2) hit cost improvement milestones, 3) tighten rollback and observability. Read quick status below and flag blockers.

Maya (VP Product): Private beta cohort = 25 customers. Gate: privacy signoff, support rota, two hallucination evals.

Lena (Head QA): We need 2 additional eval sets and one focused user-flow test. ETA for test results: Thu EOD.

Raj (VP Eng): Canary status: cache-policy at 15% with no errors. Plan: advance to 40% tomorrow if stable. Also have a PR for safer preload logic (addresses yesterday's OOMs).

Sam (Head SRE): Incident note: a stale GC config caused elevated tail latencies during a spike; mitigated by rolling GC tuning and a temporary concurrency cap. No data loss. Postmortem draft incoming.

Sam (Head SRE): Live metrics (24h): p95 gen 162ms; p99.9 1.9s; errors 0.14%; tokens/day 3.5B; dedicated saturation 82%.

Tess (Head Finance): Cost update: blended infra ~$138/1M tokens this week. Target $120/1M by quarter end. Immediate levers: (a) workload quantization POC, (b) prefix caching for high-volume tenants, (c) tighter default max-seq. I'll share a short plan Wed morning.

Elena (CEO): Exec asks: by Wed 10:00 PT, each lead posts a one-line blocker + owner in #release-war-room. By Fri EOD, Eng+Finance send 3 concrete cost actions with estimated $/1M impact.

Maya (VP Product): Proposal: freeze non-critical feature merges until beta clears 7 days without rollback. Thoughts?

Raj (VP Eng): Support freeze; label exceptions with #expedite and require cross-team signoff.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to prod-dedicated 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z (stage 15%->40%). Link: https://deploys.internal/2187654321

Lena (Head QA): I'll coordinate quick regression runs with QA and post the results in this thread.

Sam (Head SRE): I'll run a small chaos test Friday on one Dedicated cluster to validate fallback behavior; will post results in #incidents.

Tess (Head Finance): Acknowledged — will post cost levers doc after sync with Raj Thursday 9:30 PT.

Elena (CEO): Thanks all — small number of high-impact actions this sprint. Daily 1-line updates here are fine. :white_check_mark:
